label: October 5–11, 2026
intro: Chinatown blazes for the Vegetarian Festival this weekend — plus a building workshop and a costume contest on Saturday!
weekday_note: A drum trial lesson at Yamaha or Rockademy midweek is the sleeper hit — Thor will talk about it for days.

activities.title: Vegetarian Festival — Yaowarat Chinatown Opening
activities.date: Friday Oct 9 – Sunday Oct 11 (festival runs Oct 9–18)
activities.location: Yaowarat Road, Chinatown (MRT Hua Lamphong or Wat Mangkon)
activities.price: Free entry — just buy street food!
activities.why: Lanterns, gold-and-red decorations, dragon processions, hundreds of vegan street food stalls. Wild sensory overload in the best way. The opening nights are always the most electric.
activities.tip: Go at 5–6 PM before it gets packed. Tofu skewers and vegan coconut desserts are Thor-friendly. Put him on your shoulders in the thick of the crowd — all festive energy, safe and fun.

activities.title: Shadowville Little Monster Costume Contest — Central Westville
activities.why: A full day of Halloween-themed kids fun with a costume contest for tiny monsters. Thor can rock his Iron Man suit or whatever he builds — great introduction to Halloween season.
activities.tip: Plan the costume in advance! Central Westville is ~30 min by Grab from Sukhumvit. Go mid-morning for the freshest energy and to check out all the decorations.

activities.title: Roblox Studio Workshop — Build Your Own Game
activities.price: Check event page for ticket price (195+ registered)
activities.why: Thor builds his own mini game in Roblox Studio — pure building-and-making energy channelled into a digital creation. Coding for 5-year-olds is creative play in disguise.
activities.tip: 195+ kids already registered so register early. kx is near BTS Makkasan. Bring Thor's tablet/laptop if he has one — or check if devices are provided.

activities.title: AniEx 2026 — Animation Exhibition
activities.location: Krung Thep Aphiwat Central Terminal (Bang Sue Grand Station), Bangkok
activities.price: Check event page for ticket price
activities.why: Anime and animation exhibition — characters, art, creators and interactive displays. If Thor loves Iron Man and Marvel, animation is his world. A visual feast at one of Bangkok's coolest new stations.
activities.tip: Take the MRT to Bang Sue Grand Station — the station itself is stunning and worth exploring. Get there at opening to avoid afternoon crowds.

activities.title: Drum Trial Lesson — Yamaha or Rockademy
activities.location: Yamaha Music School (multiple BKK branches) or Rockademy, Sukhumvit 26
activities.price: Yamaha: ~800–1,200 THB for a 30-min trial · Rockademy: call for rate
activities.why: Thor loves drums — put him behind a real kit with a proper instructor. Yamaha does excellent kids intro programs; Rockademy (Sukhumvit 26, Tue–Sun) is for slightly older learners but worth checking.
activities.tip: Call Yamaha's nearest branch and ask for a kids drum intro session. He'll be keeping a beat by the end. Rockademy: 02-261-3833, Sukhumvit Soi 26.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum — Chatuchak
activities.location: 810 Kamphaeng Phet 4 Rd, Chatuchak (BTS Mo Chit)
activities.why: Construction zone, science experiments, dinosaur dig sandbox, water play — all free. This is Thor's dream weekday escape.
activities.tip: Bring a change of clothes for the water zone. Combine with Chatuchak Park for a picnic lunch. Go on a weekday to have the place mostly to yourselves.

activities.title: National Science Museum Day Trip (NSM, Rangsit)
activities.location: National Science Museum, Pathum Thani (~45 min by Grab)
activities.why: Multiple massive hands-on buildings — robots, engineering, natural history, tech. Thor can build, experiment and explore all day. Far bigger and better than city museums.
activities.tip: Grab car ~350 THB each way. Arrive early. Bring lunch — café is small. Allow at least 3 hours. Check nsm.or.th for current exhibitions.

activities.title: Ice Skating at The Rink — CentralWorld
activities.location: The Rink, Floor 2 Zone Forum, CentralWorld (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.price: ~260 THB/session (90 min, skate rental + helmet included)
activities.why: Classic Saturday morning skate — early weekend sessions are lightly attended and the ice is fresh. Combine with a Vegetarian Festival evening for the ultimate day.
activities.tip: Go at 10 AM Saturday and combine with the Vegetarian Festival at 5 PM for a packed-full amazing day.
